snippet.title: Ghost Cam - Official Demo Trailer | Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025
snippet.description: Ghost Cam is a spooky ghost photography game where you search for spirits to capture—but discover what happens if a ghost captures you. Watch the latest Ghost Cam trailer to see what you can expect ahead of the game's launch on Meta Quest. A demo will be available on Meta Quest on January 9, 2026.
